Look folks, this is the bitter fruit of foreign entanglements and distant geopolitical chaos, specifically the conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. It directly hits hardworking families at the pump and threatens our economic sovereignty because of our reliance on crude oil imports. 

Now, the government has stepped in by reducing excise duties to shield consumers, but make no mistake—there is no free lunch. These big-government interventions come at a direct cost to government revenue and risk fueling inflation. This is a stark reminder that true national security and family values demand energy independence, strict fiscal responsibility, and putting our own people first before these foreign messes wreck our domestic economy.
